headline: 99 merges in 48 hours — and now the shift report writes itself
lede: Sun Oct 18 → Tue Oct 20 PT. The builder shipped the shift report itself: this page regenerates every 4 hours and every number on it is computed — the only prose here is a builder's notes.

notes.text: The Mac mini ran hot in every sampled hour; the Studio has sat near load 16 since a second stream started on it.
Median PR waits ~13 min — that's CI, not review. 51 runs cancelled, most on main, each superseded by the next merge.
The builder-idle band is now computed from telemetry (last builder merge until the next builder process) instead of eyeballed.
Questions left STATE.md for issues (#605). This session shipped #614; defaults take #633–#635 by Oct 22 unless Jon answers first.
